bagPolicy.summary: One clear bag up to 12" x 6" x 12" or a one gallon clear Ziploc style bag is allowed, plus a small purse up to 4.5" x 6.5". No bag check.
allowed: One clear PVC or vinyl bag up to 12" x 6" x 12"
One gallon clear Ziploc style bag
Small purse or wallet up to 4.5" x 6.5"
Medical bags after search and tagging
Diaper bags when a child is present, after search
Blankets and extra clothing carried loosely or in an approved clear bag
prohibited: Purses or wallets larger than 4.5" x 6.5"
Non-clear bags inside a clear bag
Any bag larger than the allowed size
Outside lawn chairs at Live Nation shows
bagPolicy.note: Medical bags do not need to be clear; tell security at the gate. The amphitheater does not check or store prohibited bags, so leave them in your car or hotel.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at Empower Federal Credit Union Amphitheater can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: Use the Pink Lot off State Fair Boulevard for pickup and drop-off. Allow a 5 to 7 minute walk to the main gate. There is no shuttle.

concessions.note: Pay by major credit card, debit card or mobile payment. Cash is not accepted. A cash-to-card kiosk at the box office loads cash onto a prepaid debit card.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible seating is offered with the same flexibility and price options as other seats. Shuttle rides are available for guests with limited mobility, and ADA parking is in the orange lot.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted after you leave the venue.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The box office is next to the main gate and opens only on show days, from 1.5 hours before the advertised show time until a half hour after the main act starts. Pick up will call tickets there with a photo ID matching the purchaser's name.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Every ticket type can use the main gate, which also has one Early Entry Lane. Gates usually open 1 to 1.5 hours before show time, and parking lots generally open 3 hours before.
